title: 第726章 二十亿大单第725章 购物
slug: 开局亿年修为弹指间秒杀一切
content_zh:
以前。
璇玑没有这个机会。
但现在，她可以将自己脑海中的想法，一一转化成现实！
“这里的东西，要如何购买？”璇玑转身，看向小丹问道。
小丹面带笑容，回道：
“这位客人，您想购买什么东西，可以直接跟我说。”
“我会一一记录下来。”
“然后，我们会安排人，将您需要的东西，提前准备好。”
“到时候，你再进行付款，我们就会将准备好的东西，一并交给您。”
“另外。”
“如果你购买的物品很多，我们这里还会给您一个优惠价格。”
“一般情况下，都不会低于九折。”
“最高，是打五折。”
听到小丹的回答，璇玑点了点头。
紧接着，她转过头看向旁边的谢晚棠和唐蝶衣。
“两位姐姐，我要买的东西有点多。”
“那个，你们身上的源晶，可不可以先借给我啊？”
“等以后，我会还给你们的。”
璇玑小心翼翼地问道。
二女闻言，微微一笑。

她们没有任何的犹豫，立即将手上的储物戒摘下来，递到璇玑的手中。
“看你这话说的。”
“什么借不借的。”
“我们的，就是你的。”
“你需要，以后尽管开口就是。”
“就是。”
“你这么拘谨做什么？”
“我们之间，又不是外人。”
二女先后开口道。
“谢谢。”
璇玑有些小感动。
放在之前。
她是想都不敢想，自己也会有这么被人如此关爱的一天。
之后。
璇玑轻点了一下所有的源晶。
加上她自己，一共有十八亿源晶。
这么多的源晶。
若是放在之前的流云城，可以说是妥妥的全城首富级别。

before.
Xuanji doesn't have this chance.
But now, she can transform the thoughts in her mind into reality one by one!
"How do I buy the things here?" Xuanji turned around and looked at Xiao Dan and asked.
Xiao Dan replied with a smile on his face:
"Guest, if you want to buy anything, you can tell me directly."
"I'll write it down one by one."
"Then, we will arrange for people to prepare the things you need in advance."
"At that time, if you make payment, we will hand over all the prepared items to you."
"Besides."
“If you buy a lot of items, we will also give you a preferential price here.”
"Under normal circumstances, it will not be less than 10% off."
"The highest is 50% off."
Hearing Xiao Dan's answer, Xuanji nodded.
Then, she turned her head and looked at Xie Wantang and Tang Dieyi beside her.
"Sisters, I have a lot to buy."
"Well, can you lend me the Source Crystal you have on you first?"
"I will return it to you later."
Xuanji asked cautiously.
When the two women heard this, they smiled slightly.
Without any hesitation, they immediately took off the storage rings from their hands and handed them to Xuanji's hands.
"Look at what you said."
"What can I borrow or not?"
"What's ours is yours."
"If you need it, just ask."
"That's right."
"Why are you so reserved?"
"We are not outsiders."
The two women spoke one after another.
"Thank you."
Xuanji was a little touched.

Xuanji tapped all the source crystals.
Including herself, there are a total of 1.8 billion source crystals.
So many source crystals.
If he were placed in the previous Liuyun City, he could be said to be at the level of the richest man in the city.
